description: This Java class, PolicyReferenceTag, represents a data structure for referencing a policy along with the entity ID that references it. It provides methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, converting to JSON, and generating identifier strings. It is used within a policy management or streaming context.

classes.name: PolicyReferenceTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a policy reference with an entity ID and policy tag, with JSON serialization and string representation capabilities.

classes.name: PolicyReferenceTag.JsonFields
classes.description: Static inner class defining JSON field names for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new PolicyReferenceTag from an EntityId and PolicyTag.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a PolicyReferenceTag instance from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID referencing the policy.

methods.name: getPolicyTag
methods.description: Returns the PolicyTag associated with the reference.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the PolicyReferenceTag to a JsonObject.

methods.name: asIdentifierString
methods.description: Returns a string combining the entity ID and policy revision for identification.
